checks.name: Primary Key Uniqueness
checks.description: Verifies that all entity primary keys are non-null and strictly unique.

checks.name: Foreign Key Referential Integrity
checks.description: Ensures all foreign keys reference existing parent entity records.

checks.name: Mandatory Fields Completeness
checks.description: Ensures no mandatory columns contain NULL or blank values.

checks.name: Domain Enumerations Validation
checks.description: Validates restricted categorical fields against industrial schema enums.

checks.name: Physical Measurement Units Consistency
checks.description: Verifies that meter and telemetry units comply with SI and IEC standards.

checks.name: Telemetry Duplicate Readings Check (Anomaly Cat 4)
checks.description: Scans for repeated telemetry samples across identical (meter_id, timestamp) pairs.

checks.name: Chronological Timestamp Ordering
checks.description: Verifies that end timestamps strictly follow or equal start timestamps.

checks.name: Tariff Schedule Date Validity
checks.description: Ensures tariff effective dates form valid non-inverted intervals.

checks.name: Tariff Timezone & Window Alignment (Anomaly Cat 3)
checks.description: Re-evaluates local facility timezone rules to detect misallocated tariff periods.

checks.name: Machine-to-Meter Topology Assignment (Anomaly Cat 5)
checks.description: Validates that telemetry machine IDs strictly match established bridge table topology.

checks.name: Hierarchical Meter Reconciliation (Anomaly Cat 1)
checks.description: Compares parent feeder active power against instantaneous sum of downstream sub-meters.

checks.name: Interval Energy Physics & Conversion (Anomaly Cat 2)
checks.description: Enforces E(kWh) = P(kW) * 0.25 to catch unit confusion between instantaneous kW and interval kWh.

checks.name: Production Batch Physical Realism
checks.description: Verifies non-negative counts and physical plausibility for all production batches.

checks.name: Machine Lifecycle State Validation
checks.description: Ensures equipment lifecycle states reflect valid operational modes.

checks.name: Non-Negative Telemetry Bounds
checks.description: Verifies that electrical power, energy, and financial costs are strictly >= 0.
